heading: Custom roles
description: Grant scoped permissions without promoting someone to Manager.
descriptionDetail: Example: managing members without integration access. Capabilities are additive — a custom role never takes away what someone's base role already allows.
name: Name
capability_access_files_desc: Browse and manage the retiring Files area
capability_manage_uploads_desc: View pending uploads and audit log
capability_manage_announcements_desc: Create, pin, edit and delete company announcements and calendar events
capability_manage_guidebooks_desc: Create and edit guidebook pages, attachments and highlights
capability_manage_blog_desc: Create, edit and publish posts on advantisgroup.de/blog
capability_manage_it_ticket_threads_desc: Start, post in, and lock/unlock chat threads on IT tickets — filing and editing tickets themselves stays open to everyone
capability_view_clockodo_team_desc: See coworkers' absence types, reports, and pending counts on /clockodo — not just your own
capability_manage_clockodo_team_desc: Approve or deny absence requests, and manage employee Clockodo accounts
capability_use_ai_desc: Use the AI features — the wiki assistant, formatting help, CV reading and asking about a record. Managers and admins have this anyway; without it, an employee sees no AI buttons and no run can start for them
deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? Anyone assigned this role loses its capabilities immediately.
capability_manage_inquiries_desc: Answer, assign and close inquiries sent through the website's contact forms, and get notified about new ones
